source: Perle swiftly focused and took her Overseer position, carefully observing the different sections of the quarry cave.
target: Perle celeriter se concentravit et munus praefectae suscepit, diversas speluncae fodinae partes diligenter observans.

source: The area was shrouded in darkness, with only a carbide lamp lying on its side providing a faint bluish‑yellow light.
target: Regio tenebris involuta erat, et sola lampada carbidica, in latere iacens, levem lucem caeruleo‑flavam parumque efferebat.

source: As she looked around, Perle spotted Lumian and Anthony.
target: Dum circumspiciebat, Perle Lumian et Anthony conspexit.

source: They were both located at the quarry cave’s exit, which marked the isolated boundary of this unique mirror world.
target: Utrumque ad exitum speluncae fodinae erant, quod fines solitarios huius unici speculi mundi designabat.

source: It wasn’t a viable escape route, leaving them trapped.
target: Non erat via apta ad evadendum, quae eos captivos reliquit.

source: Lumian stood facing Perle, wearing the Flog boxing gloves with iron‑black spikes.
target: Lumian, ad Perlem conversus, stetit, gerens manubria pugilistica Flog quae spinis ferri nigri ornata erant.

source: He gripped a brass revolver in his hand.
target: Manu sua revolver ex aere tenuit.

source: Anthony took cover behind him, their backs almost touching.
target: Anthony se post eum abscondit, quorum dorsa paene inter se contigebant.

source: The Hypnotist, however, wasn’t standing.
target: Hypnotista, autem, non stabat.

source: He was down on one knee, using a blank sketchbook propped on his right thigh as a surface to quickly draw something with a short pencil.
target: In uno genu iacebat, librum delineationum inanis, in dextro femore appositum, ut substratum celeriter aliquid delineare per calamum breve uteretur.

source: Bottle of Fiction!
target: Vas Fictum!

source: Lumian and Anthony found themselves inside a Bottle of Fiction, formed from the quarry cave’s exit.
target: Lumian et Anthony se invenerunt in Vas Fictum, quod exitus speluncae fodinae efformatus erat.

source: But this was pointless against Perle, who had a complete overview of the current mirror world.
target: Sed hoc contrarium Perlei frustra erat, quae plenam perspicientiam de mundo speculi hodierno habebat.

source: She could easily see where Lumian and Anthony were hiding.
target: Ea facile videre poterat ubi Lumian et Anthony se celaverant.

source: As she watched the scene unfold, Overseer Perle felt a strange, unsettling aura, as if it involved a gray domain.
target: Dum scaenam evolventem spectabat, praefecta Perle auram insolitam et perturbantem sensit, quasi regnum cinereum implicaretur.

source: Lumian, as the team’s leader and most powerful member, appeared to be buying the Spectator more time.
target: Lumian, ut dux turmae et potentissimus membrum, videbatur Spectatori tempus emere.

source: Whether he was gambling on her unwillingness to kill him, hoping to capture him alive, so he could be used as a shield, it was evident that the Spectator’s actions were critical.
target: Utrum aleam faceret ex eius voluntate non eum interficendi, sperans eum vivum captum iri ut scutum adhiberetur, patebat Spectatoris actus esse cruciales.

source: Lumian believed it could either harm her—an Overseer—or help them evade an Overseer!
target: Lumian credebat id aut eam laedere posse—praefectam—aut eos a praefecta evadere adiuvare!

source: Without hesitation, Perle fixed her gaze on Lumian and Anthony within the Bottle of Fiction and declared in the Words of Order, “An Overseer sees all secrets!”
target: Sine dubitatione, Perle oculos suos in Lumian et Anthony intra Vas Fictum dirigens, verbis ordinis declaravit: “Praefecta omnia arcana videt!”

source: The moment she uttered those words, the Bottle of Fiction at the quarry cave’s exit quietly disintegrated.
target: Momeno quo illa verba edixit, Vas Fictum ad exitum speluncae fodinae leniter dissolutus est.

source: However, Perle noticed that while Lumian was no longer shielded by the Bottle of Fiction, Anthony still remained inside one.
target: Tamen Perle animadvertit quod, dum Lumian non iam vas fictum servabat, Anthony adhuc intra illud remanebat.

source: The Overseer’s words had failed to dispel it!
target: Verba praefectae eam dissolvere non potuerunt!

source: Confirming this detail, Lumian smiled.
target: Hoc confirmans, Lumian subridit.

source: The Bottle of Fiction surrounding Anthony was created using him as a base.
target: Vas Fictum, quod Anthony circumdabat, eum ut fundamentum adhibitum creatum erat.

source: His spread legs and the ground created a symbolic doorway.
target: Crura diffusa et terra ianuam symbolicam creaverunt.

source: Lumian’s body arched slightly as he faced Overseer Perle.
target: Corpus Lumiani paulum arcuatum est, dum praefecta Perlem spectabat.

source: His smile twisted as he muttered under his breath, “Yes, Anthony is carrying out a crucial task under my guidance.
target: Risus eius contorti sunt, dum submurmurans dixit: “Ita, Anthony munus cruciale sub mea ductu peragit.

source: But to break the Bottle of Fiction made from a living person like me, you must defeat me first.
target: Sed ut vas fictum, ex persona viva simili me factum, frangeris, me primum superare debes.

source: Anyone trying to harm Anthony will have to go through me!
target: Quicumque conabitur Anthony laedere, per me transire necesse erit!

source: I am now Anthony’s shield.
target: Nunc ego scutum Anthoni sum.

source: I am the wall that protects him!”
target: Murus sum qui eum tuetur!”

source: Perle’s smile diminished slightly as she regarded Lumian with a grave expression.
target: Subrisus Perlae leviter deminutus est, dum Lumian vultu gravi intuebatur.

source: “You stand guilty!
target: Tu es reus es!

source: You murdered someone!”
target: Aliquem interfecisti!”

source: Murder… Lumian’s heart skipped a beat.
target: Homicidium… cor Lumiani titubavit.

source: He wasn’t surprised by the fact that he had killed someone, but he didn’t expect Overseer Perle to charge him with such a crime.
target: Non miratus est quod aliquem interficeret, sed non exspectavit praefectam Perlem eum tali scelere accusare.

source: No matter the form of the ensuing punishment, the ultimate outcome was set in stone.
target: Quamvis forma poenae secutae, exitus finalis in lapide inscriptus erat.

source: A murderer met his end!
target: Homicida suum finem obiit!

source: Doesn’t she want to take me alive? Lumian had voluntarily become Anthony’s shield, believing that Perle wouldn’t risk killing him.
target: Non vultne illa me vivum capere? Lumian voluntarie scutum Anthoni factus erat, credens Perlem eum necandum non auditurum esse.

source: This would limit many of her abilities.
target: Hoc multas eius facultates restringeret.

source: He hoped to buy time until Anthony finished the sketch on the Beyonder painting album he had gotten from Bard.
target: Spem habebat tempus emere, donec Anthony delineationem in albume picturae Beyonder, quod a Bardo adeptus erat, finiret.

source: The album’s purpose was to bring drawings to life or manifest special effects for a period.
target: Propositum albumi erat delineationes ad vitam revocandas aut effectus especiales pro certo intervallo manifestandos.

source: Unexpectedly, this plan fell apart from the start.
target: Inopinanter, hoc consilium ex initio dissolutum est.

source: Of course, Lumian didn’t bet everything on the possibility of the Overseer only wishing to capture him alive.
target: Certe, Lumian non cuncta in spe posuit, ut praefecta eum solum vivo capturum cupiret.

source: It was impossible for him to defeat a demigod, but he had some hope at buying time.
target: Ei impossibile erat semideum superare, sed aliquam spem temporis emendi habebat.

source: A muffled thunderclap resounded in the low ceiling of the quarry cave.
target: Tonitrua opaca resonaverunt in humili laquearia speluncae fodinae.

source: Silver‑white lightning serpents sprang forth, intertwining into a tree of lightning as wide as a barrel, aimed at Lumian.
target: Angues fulminis argenteo‑albi exsiluerunt, in arborem fulminis latissimam ut dolium implicantes atque ad Lumian intendentes.

source: Before the thunder echoed and the lightning struck, Lumian had already lifted his hand, pointing the brass revolver at the world’s punishment.
target: Antequam tonitrua resonarent et fulmen percuteret, Lumian iam manum extulit, revolver ex aere ad poenam mundi intendens.

source: His blue eyes turned iron‑black, but he couldn’t perceive any weakness in the terrifying lightning.
target: Oculi eius caerulei in ferreo nigro versi sunt, sed nullam infirmitatem in terribili fulmine deprehendere potuit.

source: His only option was to channel blazing white flames into the revolver and the bullet about to be fired.
target: Unica optio eius erat flammam albae fulgentis in revolver atque in pilam iam emittendam infundere.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: As the threatening silver‑white tree of lightning hurtled down, a bullet glowing with dark green flames shot from the muzzle, colliding with the immense lightning bolt.
target: Dum arbor fulminis argenteo‑albi minax deorsum ruat, pila obscuro‑viridibus flammis fulgens ex canna emissa est, collidens cum ingenti fulminis ictu.

source: Weakening Bullet!
target: Pila Debilis!

source: This was the Weakening Bullet he had obtained from Jebus!
target: Haec fuit Pila Debilis quam a Jebus adeptus erat!

source: Instantly, the barrel‑thick lightning bolt shattered the dark‑green bullet and the blazing white flames encasing it.
target: Statim, fulmen crassum, quasi tuba, pilam viride obscuram et flammas albas ardentes, quae eam cinxerant, confringit.

source: A blinding silver‑white light engulfed Lumian.
target: Lux argenteo‑alba caeca Lumian obvolvit.

source: Boom!
target: Tum!

source: A horrifying roar assaulted Anthony’s ears, causing his body to shudder involuntarily, nearly deafening him.
target: Clamor terribilis auribus Anthoni irruit, corpus eius involuntarie concutens, paene eum surdum faciens.

source: He remembered the night the cultists attacked the army camp.
target: Meminit noctis in qua cultores castra exercitus oppugnaverunt.

source: Gunfire, cannon blasts, screams, and shouts came from every direction, overwhelming him with panic and fear.
target: Telis igniferis, tormentis cannonum, clamores ac exclamationes ex omni parte pervenerunt, eum terrore et timore opprimentes.

source: It had left a profound psychological scar that took years to heal.
target: Reliquit cicatricem psychologicam profundam, quae multos annos ad sanandum requiruit.

source: Now, he felt as if he had been transported back to that moment.
target: Nunc sensit quasi ad illum tempus rediisset.

source: Anthony gathered himself and looked at the blank sketchbook before resuming his sketch.
target: Anthony se componit et librum delineationum inanimem observavit, deinde delineationem resumere coepit.

source: The pencil in his hand rustled as it moved.
target: Calamus in manu eius susurravit dum movebatur.

source: He could still vividly recall Lumian’s body language: “Unless I die and someone steps over my corpse, no one can harm you!”
target: Adhuc vividissime recordabatur motus corporis Lumiani: “Nisi moriar et quis super cadaver meum calcet, nemo tibi nocere potest!”

source: Compared to the helplessness and terror of that night at the military camp, where everyone was in peril, Anthony felt the current situation wasn’t as dire.
target: Comparata cum inopia ac terrore illius noctis in castris militaribus, ubi omnes in periculo erant, Anthony sensit rem prae se non tam gravem esse.

source: At the very least, I have a dependable companion!
target: Saltem, comitem fidum habeo!

source: At the very least, someone is willing to risk their life to protect me!
target: Saltem, aliquis paratus est vitam suam periclitare ut me protegat!

source: Amidst the innumerable silver lightning serpents, Lumian’s body first fractured into mirror shards, then charred and crumbled into dust—the Mirror Substitution Jenna had provided him!
target: Inter innumeros angues fulminis argentei, corpus Lumiani primo in fragmenta speculi divisum est, deinde comburatum atque in pulverem dissolutum est — substitutio speculi quam Jenna ei praebuerat!

source: Lumian’s figure reappeared, standing firm in his spot with his legs slightly parted.
target: Figura Lumiani iterum apparuit, stans firmiter in loco suo cum cruribus leviter divisis.

source: Rumble.
target: Fragor!

source: The thunder in the sky didn’t fade with the previous punishment.
target: Tonitrua in caelo non defecerunt cum poena priore.

source: A new round of execution was brewing.
target: Nova series supplicii imminebat.

source: Since the Overseer had prosecuted, the punishment would persist until the target was well and truly dead!
target: Cum praefecta prosecutus fuerit, poena perseveraret usque ad finem, donec scopus vere mortuus esset!

source: Lumian’s scalp prickled, and his black hair stood on end from the lingering electricity in the air.
target: Capillitium Lumiani formidine excitatum est, et capilli nigri eius, propter electricitatem manentem in aere, erecti erant.

source: Seconds later, an even more magnificent and terrifying colossal lightning bolt silently descended.
target: Post paucis secundis, fulmen colossale, adhuc magnificum et terribile, silentio descendit.

source: Already clenching his teeth, Lumian tossed aside his revolver and raised his hands, allowing the Flog boxing gloves with iron‑black thorns to precisely meet the lightning’s tip.
target: Iam dentes stringens, Lumian revolver suum deiecit et manus elevavit, permittens ut chirothecas pugilisticas Flog, cum spinis ferri nigri, apicem fulminis accurate convenirent.

source: Blazing white fireballs materialized above him.
target: Globuli ignis albi ardentes super eum apparuerunt.

source: The Flog boxing gloves could withstand an attack imbued with godhood at the cost of shattering or cracking!
target: Chirotheca Flog pugilistica oppugnationem divinitate imbutam sustinere poterat, etsi fractura vel fissura occurreret!

source: Boom!
target: Pum!

source: Amidst the abrupt, devastating explosion, the silver‑white tree of death, composed of lightning, stopped at Lumian’s fist and the Flog boxing gloves.
target: Inter subito, vasto et devastante impetu, arbor mortis argenteo‑alba, ex fulmine composita, ad pugnus Lumiani et chirothecas Flog sistit.

source: Rumble.
target: Fragor!

source: Blazing white flames burst forth, driving the tiny lightning serpents back.
target: Flammae albae ardentes eruperunt, angues fulminis parvos repulsantes.

source: The lightning punishment quickly subsided, but the muffled rumble in the air lingered.
target: Poena fulminis celeriter cessavit, sed murmure opaco in aere manebat.

source: With multiple resounding cracks, Lumian’s Flog boxing gloves turned charred and cracked, shattering into countless pieces that rained down.
target: Multiplicibus sonorum fissuris, chirotheca Flog pugilistica Lumiani in carbonem et fracta dispersa sunt, in innumerabilia fragmenta quae quasi pluvia ceciderunt.

source: Seeing a fresh round of lightning about to form, Lumian knew he shouldn’t, but he couldn’t resist urging Anthony inwardly, “Why isn’t it done yet? I can only hold on a little longer!”
target: Videns novum circulum fulminis fore, Lumian scivit se non agendum esse, sed tamen interne Anthony impellere non potuit, dicens: “Cur nondum confectum est? Paululum tantum adhuc sustinere possum!”

source: After a brief, suffocating silence, a silver‑white giant lightning serpent abruptly struck from midair, illuminating the entire quarry cave and the smile on Overseer Perle’s face.
target: Post brevissimam atque suffocantem silentium, gigas anguis fulminis argenteo‑albus subito ex medio aëris impetum fecit, totam speluncam fodinae et risum in facie praefectae Perle illustrans.

source: Lumian only had time for one thing.
target: Lumian tantum unam rem tempori habebat.

source: He animated his shadow and switched places with it.
target: Umbram suam animavit et cum ea locum commutavit.

source: Boom!
target: Pum!

source: Amid the sharp and urgent thunderstorm, the giant lightning serpent consumed the shadow, instantly vaporizing it without a trace.
target: Inter acute et ardenter tonantem tempestatem, gigas anguis fulminis umbram consumpsit, eam statim sine ulla vestigio vaporavit.

source: At last, this round of punishment concluded, and Lumian reappeared in front of Anthony.
target: Denique haec series poenae finem attigit, et Lumian coram Anthoni iterum apparuit.

source: His legs were slightly apart, and his back was somewhat hunched, but no shadow remained under his feet.
target: Crura eius parum divisa erant, et dorsum aliquantum incurvum, sed nulla umbra sub pedibus eius remansit.

source: Why isn’t it finished yet? Lumian thought anxiously.
target: Cur nondum confectum est? Lumian anxie cogitavit.

source: He considered dismantling the Bottle of Fiction and teleporting Anthony around.
target: Cogitavit de dissolvendo Vas Fictum et de Anthoni circum transferendo.

source: However, he could tell that the Overseer’s prosecuted punishment wouldn’t end simply because he changed positions.
target: Tamen intellexit poenam, quae a praefecta prosecutus erat, non finiri solum quia locum mutaverit.

source: With the speed of lightning, he couldn’t depend on teleportation to evade it.
target: Cum velocitate fulminis, in teleportatione ad illud evadendum non poterat confidere.

source: It wasn’t a matter of teleportation being too slow, but rather the time he needed to activate the black mark on his right shoulder.
target: Non quaerat quod teleportatio nimis tarda sit, sed temporis ad notam nigram in humero dextro activandam opus esset.

source: Rumbling thunder resonated in Lumian’s ears, heralding the impending punishment.
target: Tonitrua rugientia in auribus Lumiani resonabant, poenam imminentem praenuntiantes.

source: Behind Lumian, sweat the size of soybeans formed on Anthony’s forehead as he crouched on one knee, drawing on his right thigh, which served as a table.
target: Post Lumian, sudor, fabarum sojarum magnitudine, in fronte Anthoni constitit, dum ille in uno genu fovebat et in dextro femore, qui quasi mensa fungebatur, delineabat.

source: The sketch’s first half was successful and completed quickly, but for some reason, the final stroke suddenly became challenging.
target: Media pars delineationis feliciter confecta atque celeriter perfecta est, sed aliqua causa, ultima linea subito ardua facta est.

source: The painting album influenced the pencil, causing it to greedily absorb Anthony’s spirituality.
target: Album picturae calamum influere fecit, quo ille aviditer spiritualitatem Anthoni absorbere coepit.

source: However, even this substantial amount of spirituality could only inch the black lines forward slowly.
target: Tamen, etiam hac substantiali spiritualitatis quantitate, solum nigros lineas lente progredi facere poterat.

source: At the same time, the edges of the blank drawing page gradually curled, igniting with transparent flames, as if struggling to contain what Anthony was about to draw.
target: Simul, margines paginae delineationis inania paulatim convoluti sunt, ignibus transparentibus accensi, quasi contendentes continere id quod Anthony delineare pararet.

source: Anthony was well aware that this painting album was not meant to display such a thing, but he had complete faith in Lumian’s judgment and persevered.
target: Anthony bene sciebat album picturae non destinatum esse ad huiusmodi rem monstrandam, sed plenam fidem in iudicium Lumiani habebat et perseveravit.

source: Rumble!
target: Fragor!

source: The muffled thunder intensified, and Anthony, within the Bottle of Fiction, could hear it clearly.
target: Tonitrua opaca intensiora facta sunt, et Anthony intra Vas Fictum ea clare audire poterat.

source: Despite being a Psychiatrist, he found himself unable to control his emotions.
target: Quamquam psychiater erat, se invenit quia affectus suos regere non posset.

source: Nervousness, impatience, anxiety, and panic surged within him.
target: Nervositas, impatientia, anxietas et pavor in eo erupere.

source: He composed himself and continued the final stroke.
target: Se composuit et ultimam lineam continuavit.

source: Seeing the terrifying silver‑white lightning on the brink of taking shape and Anthony still silent behind him, Lumian felt a wave of despair.
target: Cum vidisset terribile fulmen argenteum formari in limite et Anthony post eum adhuc silentem, Lumian desperationis fluctum sensit.

source: Am I about to die?
target: Moriarne?

source: Very well, I’d like to see what Termiboros looks like!
target: Bene, vellem videre qualis Termiboros esset!

source: Death… Suddenly, a flash of inspiration illuminated Lumian’s mind.
target: Mors… Subito, scintilla inspirationis mentem Lumiani illustravit.

source: He retrieved an item from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Ex sacco viatoris rem extraxit.

source: It was a golden mask adorned with several dashes of oil paint.
target: Erat larva aurea, paucis spicis picturae oleatae ornata.

source: He had obtained this golden mask from Hisoka, and it originated from Death!
target: Larvam hanc auream a Hisoka adeptus erat, et a Morte orta erat!

source: Lumian swiftly put on the golden mask, his body rapidly growing cold as his aura gradually dissipated.
target: Lumian celeriter larvam auream induit, corpus eius celeriter frigescens, dum aura eius paulatim evanuit.

source: The terrifying lightning punishment brewing in midair abruptly came to a standstill.
target: Terribilis poena fulminis, quae in medio aëris fervebat, subito cessavit.

source: Lumian gazed up at the silver‑white electric serpents that no longer converged, his lips curling beneath the golden mask.
target: Lumian sursum aspexit ad angues electricae argenteo‑albae, qui non iam conveniebant, labris eius sub larva aurea incurvatis.

source: He had become an undead creature!
target: Factus erat creatura ex morte restituta!

source: One of the golden mask’s purposes was to transform the wearer into an undead being while preserving their intelligence!
target: Unus ex finibus larvae aureae erat ut indutum in creaturam ex morte restitutam converteret, dum intelligentiam eius servaret.

source: Since Lumian was now “dead,” the punishment had fulfilled its purpose.
target: Cum Lumian nunc “mortuus” esset, poena propositum suum impleverat.

source: It naturally came to an end!
target: Naturaliter finem habuit!

source: Witnessing this, the Overseer was momentarily taken aback before grasping the situation.
target: Haec videns, praefecta breve obstupuit antequam rem intellexit.

source: She chuckled, but her composure remained intact.
target: Risu emicuit, sed constantia eius intacta mansit.

source: While the punishments descended, she had not sat idle and had prepared for any unforeseen circumstances.
target: Dum poenae descendebant, illa non sedebat inops, sed omnia casus inopinatos praeparaverat.

source: She used a coin bag to execute an Under the Table transaction.
target: Saccum nummorum ad transactionem sub mensa exsequendam usus est.

source: Her right hand was about to withdraw.
target: Manus dextra eius iam recedebat.

source: Behind Lumian, Anthony watched as the curled‑up edge and invisible flames rapidly spread to the center of the painting page, intensifying his despair.
target: Post Lumian, Anthony spectabat, dum margines convoluti et flammae invisibiles celeriter ad medium paginae delineationis diffuserentur, desperationem eius intensificantes.

source: Even if he managed to complete the final stroke, the drawing paper would be rendered useless—nothing effective would come out of it.
target: Etiamsi ultimum ictum perfici posset, charta delineationis inutilis facta esset—nihil efficax ex ea proveniret.

source: Anthony gritted his teeth, choosing to trust his companion and Lumian.
target: Anthony dentes conpressos tenuit, socium suum et Lumian confidere elegit.

source: He recalled Lumian’s instructions: “Draw Monette first before drawing Madam Magician!”
target: Meminit praecepta Lumiani: “Depinge Monette primo, deinde Madam Magician!”

source: Monette, the Islander swindler Monette…
target: Monette, fraudatrix insulana…

source: The instant this thought crossed Anthony’s mind, he was astonished to see the painting paper’s edge halt and the invisible flames temporarily freeze.
target: Instante hoc in mente Anthoni apparuit, stupuit videre marginem charta delineationis sistentem et flammas invisibiles pro tempore congelatas.

source: His pencil movements became smoother.
target: Motus calamī eius leviores facti sunt.

source: Mustering his spirituality, he finished drawing a monocle outlined by simple lines on the right eye of the thin‑faced Islander with sunken eyes, thick lips, and slightly curly black hair.
target: Spiritualitatem colligens, finivit depingere monoculum, simplicibus lineis circumscriptum, in oculo dextro insulanae vultu tenui, oculis infuscatis, labris crassis et capillis nigris paulo crispatis.
